mapper.select:
/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectManageSessions */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS attendanceCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED' ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
ORDER BY CASE A.STATUS_CD WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'OPENED' THEN 2 WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END , A.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionDetail */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.EDU_TYPE_CD AS eduTypeCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT_BODY AS contentBody , A.CONTENT_FORMAT_CD AS contentFormatCd , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.ENTRY_PWD AS entryPwd , A.EXIT_PWD AS exitPwd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , A.MANAGER_GPS_LAT AS managerGpsLat , A.MANAGER_GPS_LON AS managerGpsLon , A.GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd , A.GPS_VERIFY_RADIUS_M AS gpsVerifyRadiusM , A.GPS_MANUAL_CONFIRM_YN AS gpsManualConfirmYn , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.CANCELLED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS cancelledAt , A.CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionGuard */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , U.NODE_CD AS managerNodeCd , A.GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND A.MANAGER_USER_CD = U.USER_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionContents */ SELECT SC.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , M.TITLE AS title , M.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I WHERE I.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS itemCnt , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder , SC.OVERRIDE_DESC AS overrideDesc FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( SC.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND SC.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = M.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionRisks */ SELECT SR.SITE_CD AS siteCd , SR.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , RA.RISK_TYPE_CD AS riskTypeCd , RT.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , RA.HAZARD_CD AS hazardCd , CASE WHEN RA.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN RA.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , SR.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , SR.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK SR INNER JOIN TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT RA ON ( SR.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND SR.SITE_CD = RA.SITE_CD AND SR.PROCESS_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND SR.ASSESSMENT_CD = RA.ASSESSMENT_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON ( RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE RT ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = RT.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = RT.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND RA.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE SR.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SR.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SR.DISPLAY_ORDER
mapper.update: /* AppAdminTbmMapper.upsertSessionState */ INSERT INTO TB_TBM_SESSION_STATE ( CMPNY_CD , SESSION_CD , CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{sessionCd} , 0 , 'PAUSED' , #{gvUserCd} , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX = NEW.CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD = NEW.SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY = NEW.LAST_UPDATED_BY , UPDATE_NO = NEW.INSERT_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
mapper.select: /* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionContentItems */ SELECT I.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , I.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , I.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS itemType , I.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , I.URL AS url , I.MTRL_DESC AS itemDesc , I.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx /* 서명 URL 전환: 파일 원시 경로/확장자(서비스에서 FileUrlSigner 로 서명). 파일 없으면 NULL. */ , F.FILE_PATH AS filePath , F.FILE_EXT AS fileExt FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC ON ( I.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO F ON ( F.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND F.FILE_MGMT_CD = I.FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' /* 회사 격리 보강: 항목이 속한 교육자료(M)가 동일 회사 소유인지 EXISTS 가드 */ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M WHERE M.MTRL_CD = I.MTRL_CD AND M.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = SC.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.SORT_IDX

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminEduMaterials */ SELECT A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , CASE WHEN A.SITE_CD IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isCommonContent , A.CONTENTS AS contents , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I WHERE I.MTRL_CD = A.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS itemCnt , A.USE_YN AS useYn , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = A.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' )
ORDER BY A.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminEduMaterial */ SELECT A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , A.CONTENTS AS contents , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , CASE WHEN A.SITE_CD IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isCommonContent , A.USE_YN AS useYn , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = A.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd}

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminEduMaterialItems */ SELECT I.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , I.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , I.MTRL_DESC AS mtrlDesc , I.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , I.THUMB_FILE_MGMT_CD AS thumbFileMgmtCd , I.DURATION_SEC AS durationSec , I.URL AS url , I.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx /* 서명 URL 전환: SQL CONCAT 제거. 원시 경로/확장자만 반환하고 서비스에서 FileUrlSigner 로 서명. */ , F.FILE_PATH AS filePath , F.FILE_EXT AS fileExt FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( I.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND M.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO F ON ( F.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND F.FILE_MGMT_CD = I.FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE I.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY I.SORT_IDX

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectMaterialTypeOptions */ SELECT BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD AS code , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS name FROM TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD WHERE BD.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY BD.SORT_IDX, BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminHistory */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS attendanceCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED' ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
ORDER BY IFNULL(A.ENDED_AT, A.INSERT_DATE) DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminHistoryStat */ SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.SESSION_CD) AS sessionCount , COUNT(AT.ATTENDANCE_CD) AS attendanceCount , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = AT.CMPNY_CD AND A.SESSION_CD = AT.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' )
